questions.question: Which one is not a measure of software science theory?

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.11; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: Checked against the printed publisher key.

questions.explanation: Halstead's Software Science suite includes Vocabulary ($\eta$), Length ($N$), Volume ($V$), Potential Volume ($V^*$), Program Level ($L$), Difficulty ($D$), Effort ($E$), Time ($T$), and Language Level ($\lambda$). There is no measure named "Logic" in Halstead's theory.
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس مقياساً في نظرية Software Science؟
questions.explanation_ar: logic ليس من مقاييس Software Science المعتمدة.

questions.question: A human mind is capable of making how many number of elementary mental descriminations per second (*i.e.*, stroud number)?

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.12; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: Checked against the printed publisher key.

questions.explanation: Halstead adopted psychologist John M. Stroud's perceptual research, which established that the human mind is capable of making between 5 and 20 elementary mental discriminations per second. In formulating practical Software Science equations, Halstead adopted the reference value $S = 18$ discriminations per second to convert mental effort $E$ into estimated programming time in seconds:
questions.question_ar: كم عدد التمييزات الذهنية الأولية التي يستطيع العقل البشري إجراءها في الثانية (stroud number)؟
questions.explanation_ar: عدد Stroud يتراوح بين 5 و20 تمييزاً في الثانية.

questions.question: Which one is the international standard for size measure?

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.15; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: مفتاح الناشر المطبوع هو D، لكنه يتعارض مع تعريف مقياس الحجم المعتمد؛ بقي السؤال بلا درجة إلى حين المراجعة.
note.en: The printed publisher key is D, but it contradicts the taught definition of a size measure; the item is ungraded pending review.

questions.explanation: No unique key can be verified from the supplied course item. The stem says “international standard for size measure,” while the options are LOC, Function count, Program length, and None of the above. The source does not define what “international standard” means here or provide an answer key. Choice (b) may be the intended classroom answer if “Function count” is being used loosely for function-oriented sizing, but that interpretation is not established by the item itself.
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي هو المعيار الدولي لمقياس الحجم؟
questions.explanation_ar: مفتاح الناشر المطبوع هو D، لكنه يتعارض مع تعريف مقياس الحجم المعتمد؛ بقي السؤال بلا درجة.

questions.question: Which one in not on object oriented metric ?

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.16; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: Checked against the printed publisher key.

questions.explanation: Response For a Class (RFC) and Coupling Between Objects (CBO) belong to the seminal Chidamber & Kemerer (CK) suite, and Data Access Component (DAC) belongs to the Li & Henry object-oriented metrics suite.
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس مقياساً كائني التوجه؟
questions.explanation_ar: OBC ليس مقياساً معروفاً في أدبيات المقاييس الكائنية.

questions.question: Depth of inheritance tree (DIT) can be measured by:

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.18; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: Checked against the printed publisher key.

questions.explanation: In companion slide 100 and textbook scan p. 305, Depth of Inheritance Tree (DIT) is defined as the number of ancestor classes (the maximum path length from the class node to the root class of the inheritance tree). Successor classes correspond to descendants/subclasses (measured by NOC - Number of Children).
questions.question_ar: عمق شجرة الوراثة DIT يمكن قياسه بـ:
questions.explanation_ar: DIT يقيس أقصى مسار من الصنف إلى جذره عبر الأصناف السلف.

questions.question: A dynamic page is:
options_en: where contants are not dependent on the actions of the user
where contents are dependent on the actions of the user
options: where contants are not dependent on the actions of the user
where contents are dependent on the actions of the user

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.19; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: مفتاح الناشر هو C، لكن الصفحة الديناميكية تعرف باعتماد محتواها على أفعال المستخدم؛ بقي السؤال بلا درجة إلى حين المراجعة.
note.en: The publisher key is C, but a dynamic page is defined by content depending on user actions; the item is ungraded pending review.

questions.explanation: Dynamic web pages are constructed on demand on the web server by executing server-side scripts and querying backend databases, where contents are dependent on the actions, requests, or session state of the user.
options_ar: حيث لا تعتمد المحتويات على أفعال المستخدم
حيث تعتمد المحتويات على أفعال المستخدم
questions.explanation_ar: الصفحة الديناميكية تبني محتواها حسب أفعال المستخدم.

questions.question: Which one is not a size measure ?

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.20; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: Checked against the printed publisher key.

questions.explanation: Cyclomatic Complexity is a control-flow structural complexity metric measuring linearly independent basis paths, not an attribute of software size. In contrast, LOC, FP, and Halstead's Program Length are recognized physical or functional size metrics.
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس مقياس حجم؟
questions.explanation_ar: cyclomatic complexity مقياس تعقيد وليس حجم.
